أنزعج (form VII)
# أَنْزَعِجُ (ʔanzaʕiju) /ʔan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# أَنْزَعِجَ (ʔanzaʕija) /ʔan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# أَنْزَعِجْ (ʔanzaʕij) /ʔan.za.ʕid͡ʒ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
